# CricBreakdown

> Independent cricket analysis covering IPL, international cricket, statistics, team breakdowns, player trades, auctions and cricket history.

## Main Sections

- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/articles — All published cricket breakdowns and analysis.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/category/ipl — IPL analysis, auction strategy, player trades, team breakdowns and form.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/category/international — Test, ODI and T20 international cricket analysis.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/category/history — Cricket Chronicles, retrospectives and notable moments.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/category/stats — Numbers-first cricket analysis and statistical breakdowns.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/about — About CricBreakdown and its editorial purpose.

## Selected Articles

- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/articles/india-vs-sri-lanka-test-galle-wtc-points-table — India vs Sri Lanka Test analysis, Manav Suthar, WTC points table and key takeaways from the Galle Test.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/articles/hardik-pandya-trade-latest-update — Hardik Pandya trade analysis and the latest reported IPL trade possibilities.
- https://www.cricbreakdown.com/articles/rcb-ipl-2027-auction-strategy — RCB IPL 2027 auction strategy, squad gaps, release candidates and auction priorities.

## Site Description

CricBreakdown publishes independent cricket analysis designed to explain the story behind scores and results. Coverage includes IPL auctions and trades, team strategy, player performances, international cricket, statistics and cricket history.

## Editorial Note

CricBreakdown is independent fan content and is not affiliated with the BCCI, ICC, or any cricket franchise.
